S1:10.text: And Abimelech ſaid: Why haſt thou deceaued vs? ſome man of the people might haue lyen with thy wife, & thou haddeſt brought vpon vs a great ſinne. And he commanded al the people, ſaying

S1:11.text: He that ſhal touch this mans wife, dying ſhal dye.

S1:13.text: And the man was made rich, and he went proſpering and encreaſing, til he was made exceeding great

S1:15.text: ſtopped at that time al the welles, that the ſeruants of his father Abraham had digged filling them vp with water:

S1:16.text: in ſo much that Abimelech himſelfe laid to Iſaac Depart from vs, becauſe thou art become mightier then we a great deale.

S1:17.text: And departing, to come to the Torrent of Gerara, and to dwel there:

S1:18.text: againe he digged other welles, which the ſeruants of his father Abraham had digged, and which, after his death, the Philiſtines had ſtopped vp of old: and he called them by the ſame names, whc'his father before had called them.

S1:19.text: And they digged in the Torrent, and found liuing water

S1:20.text: but there alſo the paſtors of Gerara made a brawle againſt the paſtors of Iſaac, ſaying It is our water. for which cauſe he called the name of the wel, by occaſion of that which had hapned, Calumne.

S1:21.text: And they digged alſo an other & for that they brawled likewiſe, and he called the name of it, Enmitie.

S1:26.text: To the which place when there were come from Gerara Abimelech, and Ocozath his freind, and Phicol chieffe captaine of his ſouldiers,

S1:27.text: Iſaac ſpake to them: Why are ye come to me a man whom you hated, and haue thruſt our from you?

S1:5.text: for becauſe Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my preceptes and commandements, and obſerued " my ceremonies & lawes. Therfore
